cases.name: signed-word-reference-signed_metadata

cases.name: signed-word-reference-context

cases.name: signed-word-reference-conversion

cases.name: signed-word-reference-arithmetic
cases.source: EXPORT WORDOPS() BEGIN Bits:=32; Signed:=0; RETURN STRING({STRING(#FE:-8h+#01:-8h),GETBITS(#FE:-8h+#01:-8h),STRING(#FF:-8h/#02:-8h),STRING(#FF:8h/#02:8h),#FF:-8h<#01:-8h,#FF:8h<#01:8h,#FF:-8h==#FF:8h,STRING(#FF:-8h+1),STRING(#01:8h+#FE:-8h),GETBITS(#01:8h+#FE:-8h)}); END;

cases.name: signed-word-reference-display_modes
cases.source: EXPORT WORDDISP() BEGIN Bits:=8; Signed:=0; LOCAL r:={STRING(#FF:-8h),STRING(#FF:8h),STRING(#FFh)}; Signed:=1; RETURN STRING(CONCAT(r,{STRING(#FF:-8h),STRING(#FF:8h),STRING(#FFh)})); END;

cases.name: signed-word-extra-reference-conversion_grid
cases.source: EXPORT WORDCGRID() BEGIN Bits:=32; Signed:=0; LOCAL vals:={-300,-129,-128,-1,0,127,128,255,256,300},out:={},k,v; FOR k FROM 1 TO 10 DO v:=vals(k); out:=CONCAT(out,{{v,STRING(R→B(v,8)),B→R(R→B(v,8)),STRING(R→B(v,-8)),B→R(R→B(v,-8))}}); END; RETURN STRING(out); END;

cases.name: signed-word-extra-reference-word_wrap

cases.name: signed-word-extra-reference-negative_ops
cases.source: EXPORT NEGOPS() BEGIN Bits:=32; Signed:=0; LOCAL v:=R→B(-5,-8); RETURN STRING({STRING(v),STRING(v/#2:-8h),STRING(v+#2:-8h),STRING(v-#2:-8h),STRING(v*#2:-8h),STRING(v<#0:-8h),STRING(v==R→B(-5,-8)),STRING(v+1),B→R(v)}); END;

cases.name: signed-word-builtins-reference-base_codes
cases.source: EXPORT BASES() BEGIN Base:=3; Bits:=32; Signed:=0; RETURN STRING({GETBASE(#FFh),GETBASE(#FF),GETBASE(R→B(255,8)),STRING(#FF),STRING(R→B(255,8))}); END;

cases.name: signed-word-builtins-reference-base_dynamic
cases.source: EXPORT BASEDYN() BEGIN Bits:=32; Signed:=0; LOCAL v:=R→B(255,8),w:=#FF; Base:=2; LOCAL r:={GETBASE(v),STRING(v),GETBASE(w),STRING(w),STRING(#FFh)}; Base:=0; RETURN STRING(CONCAT(r,{STRING(v),STRING(w),STRING(#FFh)})); END;

cases.name: signed-word-builtins-reference-set_base
cases.source: EXPORT BASESET() BEGIN Base:=3; Bits:=32; Signed:=0; LOCAL b,r,out:={}; FOR b FROM 0 TO 5 DO IFERR r:={b,GETBASE(SETBASE(#FF:-8h,b)),GETBITS(SETBASE(#FF:-8h,b)),STRING(SETBASE(#FF:-8h,b))}; THEN r:={b,"error"}; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); END; RETURN STRING(out); END;

cases.name: signed-word-builtins-reference-set_bits
cases.source: EXPORT BITSSET() BEGIN Base:=3; Bits:=32; Signed:=0; LOCAL vals:={-64,-63,-8,-1,0,1,8,63,64,65},k,b,r,out:={}; FOR k FROM 1 TO 10 DO b:=vals(k); IFERR r:={b,GETBITS(SETBITS(#FF:-8h,b)),STRING(SETBITS(#FF:-8h,b)),B→R(SETBITS(#FF:-8h,b))}; THEN r:={b,"error"}; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); END; RETURN STRING(out); END;

cases.name: signed-word-builtins-reference-default_setters
cases.source: EXPORT DEFSET() BEGIN Base:=3; Bits:=8; Signed:=1; LOCAL v:=#FFh; RETURN STRING({GETBASE(SETBASE(v)),GETBITS(SETBITS(v)),STRING(SETBASE(v)),STRING(SETBITS(v)),GETBITS(R→B(-1)),STRING(R→B(-1))}); END;

cases.name: signed-word-operations-reference-mixed_type
cases.source: EXPORT MIXCTRL() BEGIN Base:=3; Bits:=32; Signed:=0; LOCAL r,out:={}; IFERR r:={TYPE(#FFh+1),STRING(#FFh+1)}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(1+#FFh),STRING(1+#FFh)}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(#FFh/2),STRING(#FFh/2)}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(#FFh^2),STRING(#FFh^2)}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(#3h^#65h),STRING(#3h^#65h)}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(#2h^R→B(-1,-8)),STRING(#2h^R→B(-1,-8))}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(#2h^#2h),STRING(#2h^#2h)}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(#FFh<1),STRING(#FFh<1)}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(#FFh<#1h),STRING(#FFh<#1h)}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(#FFh==#FFh),STRING(#FFh==#FFh)}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(SETBITS(-300,-8)),STRING(SETBITS(-300,-8))}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(SETBASE(-300,4)),STRING(SETBASE(-300,4))}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(B→R(12)),STRING(B→R(12))}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); RETURN STRING(out); END;

cases.name: word-logic-real-bits-reference-logic
cases.source: EXPORT WLOGIC() BEGIN Base:=3; Bits:=32; Signed:=0; LOCAL r,out:={}; IFERR r:={TYPE(#F0h AND #0Fh),STRING(#F0h AND #0Fh)}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(#F0h OR #0Fh),STRING(#F0h OR #0Fh)}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(#F0h XOR #0Fh),STRING(#F0h XOR #0Fh)}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(NOT #FFh),STRING(NOT #FFh)}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(NOT #0h),STRING(NOT #0h)}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(BITSL(-5,1)),STRING(BITSL(-5,1))}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(BITSR(-5,1)),STRING(BITSR(-5,1))}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(BITNOT(0)),STRING(BITNOT(0))}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(BITAND(-5,3)),STRING(BITAND(-5,3))}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(BITNOT(1e12)),STRING(BITNOT(1e12))}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(BITAND(1e12,3)),STRING(BITAND(1e12,3))}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(BITSL(R→B(-5,-8),64)),STRING(BITSL(R→B(-5,-8),64))}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(BITSL(R→B(-5,-8),128)),STRING(BITSL(R→B(-5,-8),128))}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); IFERR r:={TYPE(R→B(#FFh,-8)),STRING(R→B(#FFh,-8))}; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{r}); RETURN STRING(out); END;

cases.name: word-logic-real-bits-reference-short_circuit
cases.source: EXPORT WSHORT() BEGIN A:=0; LOCAL r:={}; r:=CONCAT(r,{0 AND (A:=A+1),A}); r:=CONCAT(r,{1 OR (A:=A+1),A}); r:=CONCAT(r,{#0h AND (A:=A+1),A}); RETURN STRING(r); END;

cases.name: word-lazy-reference-variables
cases.source: BUMP() BEGIN A:=A+1; RETURN #0Fh; END; LOGPARAM(x,y) BEGIN RETURN x OR y; END; EXPORT LAZYWORD() BEGIN Base:=3; Bits:=32; Signed:=0; A:=0; LOCAL v:=#F0h,r:={}; r:=CONCAT(r,{v OR #0Fh,LOGPARAM(v,#0Fh),v OR BUMP(),A}); A:=0; r:=CONCAT(r,{#FFFFFFFFh OR BUMP(),A}); A:=0; r:=CONCAT(r,{R→B(-1,-8) OR BUMP(),A}); A:=0; r:=CONCAT(r,{v AND BUMP(),A,TYPE(v OR 1),STRING(v OR 1),TYPE(v AND 1),STRING(v AND 1)}); RETURN STRING(r); END;

cases.name: word-default-width-reference-getter_tiny

cases.name: word-consumers-settings-reference-settings
cases.source: EXPORT WSETTINGS() BEGIN LOCAL out:={},r,k; FOR k FROM 1 TO 9 DO Base:=3; Bits:=32; Signed:=0; IFERR IF k==1 THEN Base:=-1; END; IF k==2 THEN Base:=4; END; IF k==3 THEN Bits:=0; END; IF k==4 THEN Bits:=65; END; IF k==5 THEN Signed:=2; END; IF k==6 THEN Bits:=64; Signed:=1; END; IF k==7 THEN Signed:=1; Bits:=64; END; IF k==8 THEN Bits:=63; Signed:=1; END; IF k==9 THEN Bits:=8; Signed:=1; END; r:="ok"; THEN r:="error"; END; out:=CONCAT(out,{{k,r,Base,Bits,Signed}}); END; RETURN STRING(out); END;

cases.name: word-consumers-settings-reference-conversion_rounding

cases.name: matrix_color
cases.source: EXPORT WCONSUME() BEGIN Base:=3; Bits:=32; Signed:=0; LOCAL v:=R→B(-1,-8),m:=[[0,0]],r; m(1,1):=v; m(1,2):=#FFh; DIMGROB_P(G1,1,1,#112233h); PIXON_P(G1,0,0,v); r:=GETPIX_P(G1,0,0); RETURN STRING({TYPE(m(1,1)),m(1,1),TYPE(m(1,2)),m(1,2),r}); END;
